description: The cheapest models that meet your constraints, ranked by price. Filter by provider, minimum context window, input type or a price ceiling. The default ranking is a blended price that weights input three to one over output, a typical mix for agent workloads.

limit.description: How many models to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

max_input_usd_per_million_tokens.description: Price ceiling for input, US dollars per million tokens.

min_context_tokens.description: Smallest acceptable context window, in tokens.

modality.description: An input type the model must accept.

provider.description: Provider name such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek or Mistral.

sort_by.description: What to rank by. Default blended.

name: llm_cheapest_models
title: Find the cheapest LLM APIs
